testCases.input: What should I do with heavy feelings instead of trying to fix them?
testCases.actualOutput: generator not evaluated in this run
testCases.expectedOutput: The author says heavy feelings are not asking for your intervention but for your attention. When you come into full awareness of what you feel, the feeling will gradually release itself. You participate in your own suffering when you delay, avoid, resist, or fracture your awareness of the feeling. When you start noticing the sensations in your body you will probably feel reactive and want to fix, change, or distract yourself from the feeling. Fixing or distracting does not work because the feeling is in you and not in the things you are fixing or changing. The feeling only asks to be metabolized and processed, and eventually it turns into an unconscious wisdom that guides you forward.
